snippet.title: GHOSTWARE: Arena of the Dead - Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Buy GHOSTWARE: Arena of the Dead - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1893370/GHOSTWARE_Arena_of_the_Dead/

No one told Molly that gamers don’t die, they respawn. Guide the recently deceased heroine on a strange journey after she awakens in a long-abandoned video game. Trapped alongside other misfits by a mysterious mastermind known as the Wizard, Molly must battle in old-school arena shooter-inspired matches to stay alive and uncover the truth about her strange surroundings. Compete in capture the flag, team deathmatches, and more while exploring stages for glitches and data peeling back layers of reality.

Want to know more about our Early Access plans?
Read here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1893370/GHOSTWARE_Arena_of_the_Dead/?beta=1
